title: Assessment of BMP responses in an in vitro model of acute ethanol toxicity
author: Habeeb, Najafi, et al.

steps.title: Treat C2C12 cells with BMP7 and EtOH
steps.instruction: Add BMP7 to C2C12 cultures to a final concentration of 50 ng/mL; after BMP7 stimulation, expose the cells to the indicated percentages of ethanol.

steps.title: Harvest cells for Western blot
steps.instruction: Lyse the BMP7/EtOH‑treated C2C12 cells to obtain whole‑cell lysates for SDS‑PAGE analysis.

steps.title: Run SDS‑PAGE and transfer
steps.instruction: Separate the lysates by SDS‑PAGE and transfer the proteins onto nitrocellulose membranes as described in reference [3].

steps.title: Probe with phospho‑specific antibodies
steps.instruction: Incubate the membranes with phospho‑Smad1/5/8 rabbit mAb (Cell Signaling Technology #13820, 1:4000) and phospho‑Akt (Ser473) rabbit mAb (Cell Signaling Technology #4060, 1:8000) primary antibodies.

steps.title: Detect with HRP secondary
steps.instruction: Incubate with HRP‑conjugated mouse anti‑rabbit IgG (Santa Cruz Biotechnology #sc‑2004, 1:10000) secondary antibody and develop using GeneTex HRP substrate solutions.

steps.title: Strip and re‑probe membranes
steps.instruction: Strip the membranes in mild stripping solution (200 mM glycine, 0.1 % SDS, 1 % Tween 20, pH 2.2), then re‑probe with total‑protein antibodies: Smad1 rabbit mAb (Cell Signaling Technology #6944, 1:4000) and Akt (pan) rabbit mAb (Cell Signaling Technology #4691, 1:50000).

steps.title: Capture chemiluminescence
steps.instruction: Acquire the chemiluminescent signal using the Omega Lum™ G Imaging System.

steps.title: Fix cells for immunofluorescence
steps.instruction: Fix BMP7/EtOH‑treated C2C12 cultures in 4 % paraformaldehyde/PBS.

steps.title: Incubate with phospho‑Smad primary
steps.instruction: Apply phospho‑Smad1/5/8 rabbit mAb (Cell Signaling Technology #13820, 1:400) primary antibody (and phospho‑Akt rabbit mAb #4060, 1:400 if desired) to the fixed cells.

steps.title: Apply secondary and Phalloidin
steps.instruction: Incubate with Cy3 goat anti‑rabbit IgG secondary antibody (Jackson ImmunoResearch #111‑165‑144, 1:500) and Alexa Fluor 488 Phalloidin (Invitrogen #A12379, 1:500) to label actin filaments.

steps.title: Mount with DAPI
steps.instruction: Mount the stained samples using Vectashield Antifade Mounting Medium with DAPI (Vector Laboratories #H1200).

steps.title: Image fluorescence
steps.instruction: Capture fluorescence images on a Zeiss Axioplan 200M upright microscope equipped with an AxioCam HRm digital camera and process the data with AxioVision 4.8.2.0 software.
